concepts.idea: We contrast the hassle (the taxi, the waiting room, the lost morning) with the solution: the clinic comes to you. Then we show the services and 24/7 coverage across Marrakech.
why: A clear message in under 10 seconds
Shows the full list of services

shots.description: Syringe, bandage, blood-test tube: each item is circled as the voice names it.
The taxi stuck in traffic, in the blazing sun.
A packed waiting room: ticket No. 47 in hand, the screen shows No. 12.
The nurse arrives at the door with her kit. The Allo Infirmier logo appears.
Blood pressure check at home. The services appear one by one, in time with the voice.
Map of Marrakech: dots light up everywhere. “24/7” badge.
End card: logo, “Lil w nhar · Marrakech kamla”, WhatsApp button, 1,500+ home visits, Instagram.

concepts.idea: A short story: a son stuck in a meeting, his mother due for her IV drip today. A WhatsApp voice note, a nurse at her home, and Mama calling back to say all is well.
why: Speaks directly to children caring for their parents

shots.description: 10 a.m., a meeting. A notification pops up: “Mama — sérum lyouma”.
Split screen: him at the office, Mama at home.
In the hallway, he sends a WhatsApp voice note to Allo Infirmier.
11:30 a.m.: his phone rings on the table, an incoming call from Mama.
At Mama’s: the nurse takes care of the IV drip, Mama is settled in her armchair.
End card: logo, “Soins f ddar · lil w nhar”, WhatsApp button, 1,500+ home visits, Instagram.
